theorems.name: Submission.iwl_cr_ce_apply_eq_of_eqOn_nhds_support
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (ψ φ : TestFormOn U n) (N : Set (Eucl P)), IsOpen N → T.support ⊆ N → (∀ x ∈ N, (ψ : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) n) x = (φ : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) n) x) → T ψ = T φ
